newsitem.title: JAPAN: Volvo to buy GDI engines from Mitsubishi - paper.
newsitem.headline: Volvo to buy GDI engines from Mitsubishi - paper.

text.p: AB Volvo has agreed to buy Mitsubishi Motors Corp's gasoline direct injection (GDI) engines for cars Volvo makes at its joint venture with Mitsubishi in the Netherlands, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.
The economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said a senior Volvo executive told the paper in Paris that Volvo would start selling passengers cars with the engines from late 1997.
Mitsubishi officials could not immediately confirm the report.
Mitsubishi has said that its GDI engine uses 35 percent less fuel than its predecessor, while reducing carbon dioxide emissions by 35 percent and increasing engine power by 10 percent.
